content.english: Our God is one, and thoughts cannot attain Him:
He lives out days, and His days are timeless.

content.transliteration: Rishon lechol rishon, ve’aḥaron lechol aḥaronim;
content.english: He is the first of all first things, and the last of all last things.

content.hebrew: נֹשֵׂא כָּל־מָקוֹם, וְלֹא יִמָּצֵא אָחוֹר וּפָנִים.
content.transliteration: Nosé kol maḳom, velo yimmatsé aḥor ufanim.
content.english: He bears every place, yet He cannot be found, [from] the back or the front.
His heavenly bannered [hosts] glorify Him in joyous songs;
Creatures and ofannim beautify Him, glorify Him;
His cherubim, and His burning seraphim, and shin’anim,
With the creatures of the Chariot, turn to sanctify Him.
He is concealed from all; around Him they camp.
Those on high and on low seek, strive [to find Him];

content.hebrew: יִשְׂרָאֵל עַם קְרוֹבוֹ לְיַחֲדוֹ בְּשִׁיר עֹנִים.
content.english: Israel, the people close to Him, respond with song, to declare His oneness.

content.hebrew: שְׁמַ֤ע אֵלַי֙ יַֽעֲקֹ֔ב וְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מְקֹרָאִ֑י אֲנִי־הוּא֙ אֲנִ֣י רִאשׁ֔וֹן אַ֖ף אֲנִ֥י אַחֲרֽוֹן׃ (ישעיהו מח:יב)
content.transliteration: Shema‘ elai Ya‘aḳov veYisra’el meḳora’i ani hu ani rishon af ani aḥaron:
content.english: Hear me, Jacob, and Israel, who are called by Me: I am He, I am the first; and I am also the last. (Isa. 48:12)

content.hebrew: שְׁמַ֖ע יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל יו֥י אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ יו֥י ׀ אֶחָֽד׃ (דברים ו:ד)
content.transliteration: Shema' yisrael Adonai elohenu Adonai eḥad.
content.english: Hear O Israel, Adonai our God is Adonai on His own. (Deut. 6:4)
